Troopers called in, the place is on fire, everything."''<br />''"Burning the incriminating evidence, I reckon. Who'd have thought it, eh, Jossie? ''' Jossie''' was an [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dog]] that belonged to the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. It would accompany its [[Unidentified Coruscant Security officer (akk handler)|handler]]&mdash;who was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]]&mdash;on patrol of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]<ref name="Order66" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> which condemned all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as traitors to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Jossie and its handler were flying patrol in a [[Coruscant Security Force assault ship|CSF assault ship]], along with the ship's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Vil (Coruscant Security Force)|Vil]], and [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic Commandos]] [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] and [[Niner Skirata|Niner]].<ref name="Order66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jossie appeared in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Order66" />
